R&N_ITB,"80, 81",6._DESIGN_AND_OPERATIONAL_REQUIREMENTS,6.2_Design_Conditions_&_Requirements,6.2.1_Air_Cool_Condenser,ACC(V),ACC(V),"Air Cooled Condenser (ACC), Condenser, Steam Turbine (ST) Exhaust, Steam Turbine Bypass System, Supporting Calculations, Wind Direction, N+1 Fans, Condenser Vacuum Optimization","ACC(V) Air Cooled Condenser (ACC), ACC(V) Condenser, ACC(V) Steam Turbine (ST) Exhaust, ACC(V) Steam Turbine Bypass System, ACC(V) Supporting Calculations, ACC(V) Wind Direction, ACC(V) N+1 Fans, ACC(V) Condenser Vacuum Optimization","The condenser shall be capable of condensing the whole of the steam exhaust from the steam turbine (including the bypass systems) under all conditions of load and operation. For this the EPC Contractor shall provide  with  his  proposal  supporting  calculations.  Additionally,  supporting  calculations  demonstrating that the wind direction at the site will not impact the performance of the ACCs shall be provided. The ACC location shall be selected so that it will not be in the predominant wind direction.
The systems and components for the ACC shall be provided by the Contractor and shall include but not limited to the following:
- Condensate extraction pumps and strainers
- Vacuum raising and maintaining system
- Turbine blow off tank
- Condensate, air extraction, recirculation, air, drain and atmospheric exhaust pipework and valves
- Vent pipework routed to a safe location
- Flash boxes (with integral connections to condenser) for feed heater and other drains
- Heat exchange sections
- Support structure and fan deck
- Steam duct / distribution system
- Condensate collection system
- Condenser air removal system
- Cooling air fans with automatic controls
- Condenser atmospheric relief devices
- Holding down bolts, plates, etc
- Local ladders, galleries and hand railing
- All driving motors with base plates, or stools for all auxiliaries
- Local instruments, gauges, control and panels
- Additional  tapping  points,  complete  with  isolation  and  all  necessary  instruments  for performance testing
- Any special lifting tackle, spanners and tools
- All other equipment required for the safe and efficient operation of the plant.
The  exhaust  steam  from  the  Steam  Turbine  exhaust  shall  be  directed  to  the  air  cooled  condenser  and condensing  system  via  a  steam  piping  and  ductwork  system
column2: the  water  will  then  be  forwarded  to  the condensate system.

column1: The condenser and the cooling system, at a minimum, shall be capable of:
- i. Condensing the total steam flow from its associated steam turbine operating at maximum flow and at maximum ambient temperature
- ii. Accepting the total steam system drain flows
- iii. Condensing the full capability of the steam turbine bypass system(s)
- iv. simultaneously  operating  with  steam  flow  through  the  steam  turbine  and  the  steam  turbine  bypass system.
The condensing plant shall be designed and guaranteed to condense the maximum exhaust steam flow from the Steam Turbine
column2: to accept the relevant steam system drains
column3: and to condense the dump steam flows from

column1: the IP and LP bypass systems under conditions of turbine start-up, rapid load reduction, partial or full load rejection and turbine trip.
The ACC shall be provided with N+1 fans where N refers to the number of fans required for the maximum load condition. There is no requirement to provide the ACC equipped with elevator.

R&N_ITB,81,6._DESIGN_AND_OPERATIONAL_REQUIREMENTS,6.2_Design_Conditions_&_Requirements,6.2.1_Air_Cool_Condenser,ACC(V),ACC(V),"ACC(V), Steam Turbine(ST) LP Exhaust, Condenser, Turbine Bypass Dumps, Dispersion Headers, Demineralized Water, Vacuum Pumps, Steam Ejectors, HEI","ACC(V) ACC(V), ACC(V) Steam Turbine(ST) LP Exhaust, ACC(V) Condenser, ACC(V) Turbine Bypass Dumps, ACC(V) Dispersion Headers, ACC(V) Demineralized Water, ACC(V) Vacuum Pumps, ACC(V) Steam Ejectors, ACC(V) HEI","The steam turbine outlet connection pieces shall be designed for smooth transition with minimal obstructions from the LP turbine exhaust to the condenser to assure negligible pressure drop.

The Air-Cooled condenser materials shall be selected to provide the necessary reliability at an economical cost taking into account that ACC is being operated with Demineralized water with proper water chemistry required by OEM guidelines. ACC OEM Design will take into consideration of proper material selection as per Demin water quality..

Vacuum raising and maintaining plant may be based on either steam ejectors or mechanical vacuum pumps. As a minimum, one start-up (hogging) duty and one running duty device shall be provided for each condenser.
Steam for air ejectors, if supplied, shall be taken from the main steam supply. A silencer shall be provided on each ejector outlet.
The hotwell tank and condensate system shall be sized in accordance with HEI standards.

R&N_ITB,82,6._DESIGN_AND_OPERATIONAL_REQUIREMENTS,6.2_Design_Conditions_&_Requirements,6.2.3_Plant_Performance,,Plant Performance,"Guaranteed Contracted Net Heat Rate (GNCHR), Guaranteed Net Continuous Power Capacity (GNCPC), Gas Turbine (GT), HRSG, Triple Pressure Reheat, Supplementary Firing, Feed Water System","Plant Performance Guaranteed Contracted Net Heat Rate (GNCHR), Plant Performance Guaranteed Net Continuous Power Capacity (GNCPC), Plant Performance Gas Turbine (GT), Plant Performance HRSG, Plant Performance Triple Pressure Reheat, Plant Performance Supplementary Firing, Plant Performance Feed Water System","turbine output at full opening of GT compressor inlet guide vane during power block operation with single gas turbine, to compensate for GT degradation and during simple cycle operation.

The configurations as proposed by Contractor shall be based on reaching the lowest Guaranteed Contracted Net Heat Rate (GNCHR) while maintaining maximum possible GNCPC to be demonstrated at COD in conditions as defined in EPC Contract.
In order to increase the competitiveness of the proposal, Contractor shall consider:
- To limit its contractor margins and uncertainties to be applied for the purpose of establishing its GNCPC and GNCHR at Early Power Unit Commercial Operation Dates and PCOD
- the application of triple pressure reheat HRSG with/without supplementary firing
- the application of evaporative/fogging/wet compression system in GT
- optimizing the HRSG exhaust gas temperature and gas side pressure drop, while considering proper means to reduce the risk of excessive corrosion
- optimizing the feed water system heat recovery performances such as steam & water side pressure drops, pinch point, approach point
- consider minimum Blow-down (0%) for the purpose of defining the GNCPC
- optimize the step-up transformers as to limit efficiency losses
- minimize the auxiliary power consumption by
- -use of best estimate auxiliary power consumption for setting the Contractor GNCPC.
- -Considering variable speed/hydraulic coupling for feed water  pumps, and gas compressors (if applicable)
- -Minimizing building free volumes to avoid excessive HVAC
- -Use of Photo Voltaic panels for plant energy consumption.
- -Use of the best estimate for the equipment and Plant degradation.
- -Optimizing the margins on the design and sizing.
- Minimizing heat losses over the bypass stacks by providing air seal cooling

Furthermore, especially in the case of discharging untreated sanitary wastewater, the bacteriological contamination can result in the occurrence and spread of water borne diseases like cholera, dysentery, typhoid, etc. Therefore, special attention has to be paid by the Contractor during its investigation of the wastewater collection area to ensure that all waste water streams are considered and will be segregated, collected and discharged in a wastewater collecting system. This also includes all the sanitary and other domestic wastewater out of all permanent and temporary site facilities and the industrial wastewater out of the process like backwash water, rinse water, chemical and acid cleaning wastes and other process wastewater which cannot be used in other ways (blow-down water, etc.).

The wastewater shall be delivered to the wastewater treatment plant in sewers or pipes made of customary and proven materials in adequate diameters according to the amount of wastewater conducted in the pipes. In the case of geodetic constraints, pumping stations must be installed in adequate numbers. In the case of using cesspools, intermediate storage is allowed. All wastewater streams discharged into the domestic waste water treatment plant shall be free of toxic and inhibitory compounds concerning the process of biological clarification or compounds that can influence the further use of the sewage sludge.
The sewage sludge should either be treated or dried for use as fertilizer or disposed of in a suitably designed landfill according to US EPA/EU specification.

R&N_ITB,89,6.4.5_Technical_requirements,,,,Technical requirements," ""RAM Assessment","Technical requirements ""RAM Assessment","The RAM assessment to be developed by the EPC Contractor and shall include the following:

- Prepare a Base Case Model analysis, providing recommendations for the improvement of overall  reliability.  Perform  sensitivity  analyses,  for  the  recommended  parameters  or equipment or for the client chosen parameters after analysing the first base case draft.

- Expected average Plant availability and reliability

- Identification of failure modes and their consequences
- Decision  support  to  determine  the  most  cost-optimal  solution  to  improve  reliability results with respect to:

- Spare part philosophy
- Mobilization times and contracts

R&N_ITB,92,6.5_Redundancy_Concept,6.5.3_Electrical_System,,,Electrical System,"MV Switchgear, LV Switchgear, Bus Coupler, Switchboard, MCC, Power Transformer, Cooling Fans, Oil Pump, DC System, Battery, Battery Chargers, UPS, EDG, BSDG, BSEDG, N-1 Redundancy, N+1 Redundancy, Black Start Operation, Arc Flash Assessment Study, Hazard Risk Category (HRC), NFPA 70, IEC Standards, Gas Turbine Package, LV Distribution, DC Distribution, OEM Standard Design","Electrical System MV Switchgear, Electrical System LV Switchgear, Electrical System Bus Coupler, Electrical System Switchboard, Electrical System MCC, Electrical System Power Transformer, Electrical System Cooling Fans, Electrical System Oil Pump, Electrical System DC System, Electrical System Battery, Electrical System Battery Chargers, Electrical System UPS, Electrical System EDG, Electrical System BSDG, Electrical System BSEDG, Electrical System N-1 Redundancy, Electrical System N+1 Redundancy, Electrical System Black Start Operation, Electrical System Arc Flash Assessment Study, Electrical System Hazard Risk Category (HRC), Electrical System NFPA 70, Electrical System IEC Standards, Electrical System Gas Turbine Package, Electrical System LV Distribution, Electrical System DC Distribution, Electrical System OEM Standard Design","- The capacity of MV, LV bus sections and the sources feeding the bus sections should be adequate to take the load of the other bus section when the bus coupler closes in case of supply failure to other bus section.
- The n-1 redundancy criteria shall be maintained for each switchboard/MCC.
- Redundancy shall be provided for cooling fans such that with one group of fan or oil pump out of service the transformer would deliver the rated output within the specified temperature rise.
- Battery and battery chargers shall be provided with N+ 1 redundancy. DC System contains 2 x 100 % Battery and 2 x 100 % Battery Chargers to meet the redundancy requirements.
- UPS shall be provided with N+ 1 redundancy.
- Each LV system switchboard shall consist of two bus sections with two incomers and one bus- coupler. Each incomer shall be supplied by 1x100% capacity transformer.

- Diesel Generator shall be provided with N+1 criteria, where EDG cum BSDG concept to be adopted. The DG sizing shall consider all possible scenarios, including emergency shutdown during black start operation. Emergency cum BSDG DG sets shall have the capability of testing even if respective block is in normal operation OR when the respective block switchgear bus have no voltage. 1 x 100% battery starting system will be applied for BSEDG.
- All electrical system switchboards shall be labelled for Hazard Risk category (HRC) as per results of ARC Flash assessment study using NFPA 70 or relevant IEC standards (as applicable).

- For Gas turbine package, redundancy concept of LV & DC distribution for equipment supplied by OEM would be of OEM's standard design.",[Fadhili] ELECTRICAL CONTROL LOGIC DIAGRAM - LV SWITCHGEAR (최종점수: 1.0491 / 기본: 0.8491),[Fadhili] WIRING DIAGRAM - MV SWITCHGEAR (최종점수: 1.0477 / 기본: 0.8477),[Fadhili] ELECTRICAL CONTROL LOGIC DIAGRAM - MV SWITCHGEAR (최종점수: 1.0418 / 기본: 0.8418),[Fadhili] TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION - LV SWITCHGEAR (최종점수: 1.0369 / 기본: 0.8369),[Fadhili] TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION - MV SWITCHGEAR (최종점수: 1.0295 / 기본: 0.8295),[Fadhili] BSEDG - CALCULATION (최종점수: 1.0076 / 기본: 0.8076),[Fadhili] POWER PLANT DIESEL GENERATOR FOUNDATION PLAN (최종점수: 0.9815 / 기본: 0.7815),[Fadhili] POWER PLANT DIESEL GENERATOR FOUNDATION REINF. R&N_ITB,92,6.5_Redundancy_Concept,6.5.4_Control_instrumentation_system,,,Control instrumentation system,"Control & Instrumentation, Redundant Instrumentation, Hot Swap Capability, Automatic Changeover, Gas Turbine Package, GT Enclosure, GT Control System, Intrinsic Safety, Explosionproof Instruments, Turbine GT/ST Protection System, GT Protection Panel, Tricon CX, Triple Modular Redundant Safety PLC, HRSG Protection, Burner Management System (BMS), Triple Redundant Transmitters, Plant Protection Signals, Steam Drum, Main Steam Parameters, I/O Cards, Software Protections, SIL Study, Voting Logic","Control instrumentation system Control & Instrumentation, Control instrumentation system Redundant Instrumentation, Control instrumentation system Hot Swap Capability, Control instrumentation system Automatic Changeover, Control instrumentation system Gas Turbine Package, Control instrumentation system GT Enclosure, Control instrumentation system GT Control System, Control instrumentation system Intrinsic Safety, Control instrumentation system Explosionproof Instruments, Control instrumentation system Turbine GT/ST Protection System, Control instrumentation system GT Protection Panel, Control instrumentation system Tricon CX, Control instrumentation system Triple Modular Redundant Safety PLC, Control instrumentation system HRSG Protection, Control instrumentation system Burner Management System (BMS), Control instrumentation system Triple Redundant Transmitters, Control instrumentation system Plant Protection Signals, Control instrumentation system Steam Drum, Control instrumentation system Main Steam Parameters, Control instrumentation system I/O Cards, Control instrumentation system Software Protections, Control instrumentation system SIL Study, Control instrumentation system Voting Logic","Redundancy for control & instrumentation shall be as given below:

- All redundant instrumentation shall have the hot swap capability. Critical Redundant equipment shall be change over automatically in case of failure one equipment / Instrument. (For Gas turbine package, the hot swap capability is not applicable due to safety reason. Especially, it is not allowed to enter GT enclosure during operation, hence any person cannot access the instruments in GT enclosure.)
- Electronic modules in GT control system shall not be removed while the gas turbine is in operation.

- In general, devices shall be preferred that contain intrinsic safety, to avoid expensive supervision/monitoring installations, possibly subject to failure (In Gas turbine package, explosionproof type instruments will be used in the hazardous area.)
- Where redundant equipment is installed, it shall be possible to perform maintenance and repair works on one equipment while the others are in service.
- Hardware part of controls & instrumentation:

- Turbine GT/ST protection system (fail-safe and dual redundant system), For Gas turbine package GT Protection Panel which will consist of Tricon CX triple modular redundant safety PLC system by Schneider Electric Systems as per Supplier's standard design is considered.
- HRSG-protection (fail-safe and triple modular redundant for BMS)
- Triple redundant transmitters for Plant protection signals such as steam drum and main steam parameters.
